question: What state does a yogi attain by resting in the seed of withdrawal at that locus?
premises: At that locus, one may rest peacefully in the being of the noble drop of perception.
Resting in the seed of withdrawal is the supporting condition.
Such a yogi attains a state of supreme measure.
inference: A yogi who rests in the seed of withdrawal and abides peacefully in the noble drop of perception becomes one of supreme measure.
uncertainties: Supreme measure denotes an experiential limit rather than a quantifiable degree.
plain_english: There, the yogi who rests in the seed of withdrawal and abides peacefully in the being of the noble drop of perception becomes one of supreme measure.
